verdict.rationale: Missive documents canned responses (templates) that can be inserted with a few keystrokes and shared with a team or the whole company. It also documents a variables templating engine for dynamic content such as the recipient's name, and the changelog confirms {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} resolve in drafts. Missing for 10: any evidence that templates can carry attachments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how templates and variables work in practice.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply

citations.quote: Instead of typing the same answer repeatedly, you write it once and insert it with a few keystrokes. In Missive, you can create a collection of canned responses and share them with a team or your entire company.
You can easily customize your responses or templates with dynamic content like your recipient's name by using our variables templating engine.
